mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO main_force_daily (trade_date, ts_code, stock_name, reason, abnormal_type, net_buy, total_buy, total_sell, buy_seat_cnt, sell_seat_cnt, org_net_buy, youzi_net_buy, north_net_buy, consensus_score, divergence_flag, d1_return, d5_return, credibility_flag, change_rate, close_price, turnoverrate, note) VALUES
(#{e.tradeDate,jdbcType=DATE}, #{e.tsCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{e.stockName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{e.reason,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{e.abnormalType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{e.netBuy,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{e.totalBuy,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{e.totalSell,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{e.buySeatCnt,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{e.sellSeatCnt,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{e.orgNetBuy,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{e.youziNetBuy,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{e.northNetBuy,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{e.consensusScore,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{e.divergenceFlag,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{e.d1Return,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{e.d5Return,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{e.credibilityFlag,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{e.changeRate,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{e.closePrice,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{e.turnoverrate,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{e.note,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
mapper.select: SELECT trade_date, ts_code, stock_name, reason, abnormal_type, net_buy, total_buy, total_sell, buy_seat_cnt, sell_seat_cnt, org_net_buy, youzi_net_buy, north_net_buy, consensus_score, divergence_flag, d1_return, d5_return, credibility_flag, change_rate, close_price, turnoverrate, note FROM main_force_daily FINAL WHERE trade_date = #{tradeDate} ORDER BY net_buy DESC
